about_us.title: About Us
about_us.subtitle: We help you discover Vietnam — book rooms, tours, and local food experiences.
about_us.mission_desc: We connect travelers with authentic experiences: hotels, tours, local foods, and Vietnam souvenirs.
about_us.value_local_desc: We prioritize local experiences and communities.
about_us.value_quality_desc: We curate partners and services for high standards.
about_us.cta_subtitle: Book a room, choose a tour, or browse destinations today.
about_us.story_desc: We started from a love for Vietnam — from Hội An’s old town to Hạ Long Bay, from street food to local tours. Our goal is to connect you with authentic, trustworthy experiences.
about_us.quote_1_text: Booking and payment were clear; the trip was exactly as promised.
about_us.quote_2_text: The tour was well organized and the guide was enthusiastic.
about_us.quote_2_author: — Guest from Ho Chi Minh City
about_us.local_regions_desc: North, Central, South — each with its own character.
about_us.local_cuisine_desc: From phở and bún to regional specialties.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: The people behind your journey.
team.team_intro: Meet the people who make your journey possible.

team.quote_text: The team is warm and professional — from advice to post-trip support, everything was well taken care of.
team.local_desc: We were born and raised in Vietnam; we know every region and want to share that with you.
team.cta_subtitle: Need advice or support? Send us a message.
